design.description: Unwrap a black velvet gift box, reveal a golden date and celebrate on a sunset beach.

html:
Dear Family,

We are getting married

Vivaan

&

Anika

Saturday · 11 December 2027

The Leela Goa

Scroll

Vivaan & Anika

A gift, with love

ForYour Family

VA

Wedding Invitation

A celebration of love

You are invited

Pull the ribbon to open

A letter for you

Unwrap our letter

Dear family & friends

We are getting married, and we want the people we love most beside us when we do.

Come for the sunset, stay for the vows, and dance with us by the sea.

With all our love,

Vivaan & Anika

Scroll to unwrap, or tap the seal

With the blessings of our families

Vivaan MalhotraSon ofMr. Arjun Malhotra & Mrs. Nandini Malhotra

&

Anika SinghaniaDaughter ofMr. Rohit Singhania & Mrs. Kavita Singhania

Save the date

Scratch to reveal

See you by the sea

SATURDAY

11

DECEMBER 2027

from four in the evening

Scratch the gold to reveal the date

Add to calendar

The evening

An evening by the sea

4:00 PMBaraatThe groom arrives along the shore to the dhol
5:00 PMVarmalaGarlands beneath the floral mandap
5:45 PMPherasSeven vows as the sun sets on the sea
8:00 PMDinnerA feast under the stars

Swipe through the evening

The venue

The Leela Goa

Mobor Beach, Cavelossim, Goa

Get directions

Kindly reply

Will you join us?

392DAYS
16HOURS
10MINUTES
Dress code

Sunset formal, in ivory, black and gold

Kindly let us know by 11th November 2027.

Guests, including you
2

We can't wait to celebrate with you

With love,

Vivaan & Anika
